sentence: Peanemizz hits harder in Spanglish than it ever will in one tongue.

wombos.definition: A peanemis delivered with natural charm and rizz — not just an analysis but a magnetically smooth, effortlessly cool deep-dive. Someone with peanemizz makes the peanemis irresistible.
A hybrid mode of speech that blends Spanish and English, switching between or mixing the two languages within conversation.
wombos.example: Growing up in a bilingual household, she naturally spoke Spanglish at home.
